doc.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Learning jazz through radio and records in Montreal
summary: Peterson says he was far from jazz centers and absorbed the music from radio and recordings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Well speaking of the word “inspiration,” I think I’m a good example of it, because I was removed from the roots of it. I came from Montreal as you know, and although it was a jazz center in Canada, it was well removed from New York, Kansas City or St. Louis or Chicago. And I had to get my background in jazz intravenously so to speak, through the radio and recordings. That was the only way I could, you know, I could ingest what was going on, was to listen to the radio at night.
